title: quakes signal
description: Recent earthquakes in Japan (JMA reports via the P2P地震情報 API, code 551), newest first, within providers.quakes.hours and at or above min_intensity. Fetched every 60 s. GET /api/signals/quakes, polled every 60 s; 404 unless providers.quakes.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. The payload is an ARRAY. Not sensitive.

ts.description: Origin time. Unix time in seconds (float).

scale.description: Max observed intensity as a P2PQuake scale code: 10=1, 20=2, 30=3, 40=4, 45=5弱, 50=5強, 55=6弱, 60=6強, 70=7.
